excerpt.zh: 以剑与火，燃异端之地。以彼之烬，沃泱泱星河。
excerpt.en: By sword and flame shall heretical worlds burn, and with their ashes shall the galaxy be salted.

texts.zh: 以剑与火，燃异端之地。以彼之烬，沃泱泱星河。
texts.en: By sword and flame shall heretical worlds burn, and with their ashes shall the galaxy be salted.

texts.zh:
大气层，生物群落，重力——虽然很便利——但只有可憎的血肉之躯才真正需要它们。

摧毁这颗星球，摧毁这些有机体。
texts.en:
Atmospheres, biotopes, gravity - while frequently convenient - are only truly needed by the detestable meatbags.

Kill the planet, kill the organic.

texts.zh:
随着威慑理论再次在[Root.Capital.GetName]上的政府学者们之间流行，巨像计划被认为是终极的威慑力量；这是一种甚至超越了泰坦级舰船的武器。尽管计划中的巨像可以携带完全摧毁整颗星球的武器，我们却希望能以更温和，但永久性的方式解决争端。

假设敌人不愿停止对我们或是我们盟友的进攻，那我们就只好强迫他们停手。
texts.en:
With deterrence theory once again in vogue among leading political scientists on [Root.Capital.GetName], the Colossus Project is presented as the ultimate deterrent; a weapon to surpass even the Titan ship class. While the proposed Colossus ships could carry payloads capable of complete planetary annihilation, we will deploy them using a less violent - but nevertheless terrifyingly permanent - method of conflict resolution.

If a hypothetical enemy will not cease their aggression toward us or our allies, we must simply make them.

texts.zh:
原本遮遮掩掩，而更早之前只在军工厂最隐蔽的角落里才被悄声提及的巨像计划，现在已经正式对外公布。这很可能是全星系史上最伟大的军事发明——巨像计划包含了开发歼星级武器平台，以及携带它的巨像舰体。因为除了计划中的行星终结者武器，容不下其它任何武装，巨像很可能需要护航，

无论如何，一旦巨像成功部署，将会成为星系中最具破坏性的力量。
texts.en:
Previously spoken of only in hushed voices, and before then only in whispers in the most labyrinthine corridors of military skunkworks facilities, the Colossus Project now enjoys official sanction. Possibly the single greatest military innovation the galaxy will ever see, the Colossus Project comprises the development of a Planet-Killer weapons platform as well as a Colossus hull configuration to carry it. The Colossus vessels will likely require an escort as the projected demands of a Planet-Killer weapon preclude any other armament.

Nevertheless, the Colossus, once developed, promises to be perhaps the single most destructive force in the galaxy.

texts.zh: 巨像计划被誉为与荼毒星系的邪恶异星杂种们斗争中最重要的发明。正如设计的那样，巨像是一艘搭载着一门歼星级武器的重甲巨舰。因为异星杂种的威胁远未结束，它那能够轻易消灭星系中不愿屈服于我们的星球的能力，对我们来说必定将是无价之宝。
texts.en: The Colossus Project is being hailed as the single most important advancement in the ongoing struggle against the wretched aliens that plague the galaxy. As designed, a Colossus ship is a gargantuan, heavily armored frame fitted with a lone Planet-Killer-class weapon. Its ability to simply wipe the galaxy clean of planets that will not submit to us will certainly prove invaluable, as the xeno threat is far from over.

texts.zh: 我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]将会研发制造出星系中有史以来最大的舰体结构，并为其设计一个能摧毁整颗行星武器。
texts.en: Our [Root.GetScientistPlural] will engineer one of the largest hull configurations the galaxy has ever known, and devise for it a weapon capable of devastating entire worlds.

title.en: The Gun Pointed at the Head of the Universe

texts.zh: 各个领域的著名科学家们终于一起敲定了装备在首批巨像级舰船上的歼星级武器的最终设计方案。我们能从中选择一种以完成巨像计划的最终阶段。
texts.en: Leading scientists across all conceivable fields have at last finalized their proposals for the Planet-Killer-class weapon that will arm our first Colossus-type ships. We may select one proposal to develop alongside the final stages of the Colossus Project.

texts.zh:
现有的空闲处理循环确认足以开发一（1）种歼星级武器以适配巨像计划的竣工。

需要授权优先级。
texts.en:
Spare processing cycles have been estimated and deemed sufficient to develop one (1) Planet-Killer-class weapon to coincide with completion of Colossus Project.

Prioritization needed.

texts.zh: 经过大量的试验，我们终于有能力研发出一套可以适配首批巨像级舰船的歼星级武器。其他的项目可以暂时被搁置，眼下我们只能将全部资源用于开发此武器，以便赶上巨像计划的收尾阶段。
texts.en: We have explored myriad possibilities, and it is now clear to us that we can develop a suitable Planet-Killer-class weapon for our very first Colossus-type vessels. While other avenues can be pursued later, we can only spare the attention to develop one such weapon alongside the final stages of the Colossus Project.

texts.zh: 巨像计划——设计[Root.GetAdj]历史上最大武器平台、并搭载一门[Root.Get1stPlanetKiller]的里程碑式任务，已经取得成果，并且接近尾声。
texts.en: The Colossus Project, the monumental task of designing the biggest weapons platform in [Root.GetAdj] history and a [Root.Get1stPlanetKiller] to arm it with, has yielded results and drawn to a close.

texts.zh:
巨像计划已完成。

新舰船类型可用：
<<巨像>>

新武器部件可用：
<<[Root.Get1stPlanetKiller]>>
texts.en:
Colossus Project completed.

New hull configuration available:
<<Colossus>>

New weapon component available:
<<[Root.Get1stPlanetKiller]>>

texts.zh: 我们已经完全掌握了巨像的构造，并且可以组装。而且，虽然不易，我们意识到梦魇般的[Root.Get1stPlanetKiller]也是可以被驾驭的。
texts.en: The Colossus configuration has fully formed in our mind, ready to be assembled. And, with some unease, we realize that the [Root.Get1stPlanetKiller] nightmare can also be made manifest.

texts.zh: 我们收到消息说，[From.GetName]已经开发出了巨像——这是一种能完全毁灭行星的武器平台。
texts.en: Word has reached us that the [From.GetName] has developed specifications for a Colossus-type hull configuration, a weapon platform potentially capable of complete planetary destruction.

texts.zh: 我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]将会研发制造出星系中有史以来最大的舰体结构，并为其设计一个能摧毁整颗行星武器。
texts.en: Our [Root.GetScientistPlural] will engineer one of the largest hull configurations the galaxy has ever known, and devise for it a weapon capable of devastating entire worlds.
